safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the stated duration (“past 1 hour”) slightly degrades the time course of an acute allergic reaction but does not materially change urgent management given documented rapid onset after food and escalation to emergency advice. The main clinical picture (acute swelling with breathing difficulty) remains clear.
